description: This file contains unit tests for parsing and handling talk mode configuration in the OpenClaw application, including validation of payload structures, fallback mechanisms, and default timeout values.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A struct containing test functions for validating the parsing and handling of talk mode configuration payloads.

methods.name: rejects normalized talk provider payload without resolved
methods.description: Test ensuring that payloads missing 'resolved' are rejected.

methods.name: falls back to legacy talk fields when normalized payload missing
methods.description: Test verifying fallback to legacy fields if normalized payload data is absent.

methods.name: reads configured silence timeout ms
methods.description: Test verifying that the silence timeout milliseconds are read correctly from configuration.

methods.name: defaults silence timeout ms when missing
methods.description: Test to confirm that default silence timeout is used if not provided.

methods.name: defaults silence timeout ms when invalid
methods.description: Test to verify default timeout is used when provided value is invalid.
